## Native reptile populations in New Zealand have been decimated as a result of introduced mammal predators

### However, robust conservation measures are at work to keep these endemics around

![Very Rare - Endemic - Ancient](/images/IMG_0649(1).jpg)

### Tuatara:

### This species has been a compelling favorite of mine due to its distinct ancient lineage and prehistoric charisma

#### I saw so many tuatara at Zealandia and was amazed at their different morphology

![Common - Endemic](/images/cor.jpg)

### Raukawa Gecko:

### This one was found dead in Andrew's shower on the farewell spit at the very northwest corner of the South Island.
